d: Chaired by former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar at 10 Rajaji Marg, the INDIA bloc’s symbolic impeachment proceedings opened with Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge presenting six charges against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, including the alleged deletion of 13.2 crore voters, unauthorized alterations to Form 6, and software centralization via ECINET. Leaders across the opposition—including Trinamool Congress MPs Sagarika Ghose and Mahua Moitra, CPI(M)'s John Brittas, and student activist Neha Bora—highlighted regional voter roll purges targeting women, youth, and minority communities.
